name: Head Cadaver
source:
Head Cadaver is the flirtatious ring leader of the ghoul’s grove, full of charm and witty remarks, though he doesn't seem to be very liked by the other employees. He wears a stained flashy vest, wings made of human arms and has a carabiner holding various keys.

He often flirts with Darcy quite explicitly, but most of Head Cadaver's comments and moves go over his head. Some of his flirtatious comments suggests that he is a transgender man.
